sequences.description: 20 flips per sequence. 'fair' = independent fair coin (P(switch)=0.5). 'switchy' = Markov process that switches face with P=0.7. 'streaky' = Markov process that switches with P=0.3. First flip is 50/50. Items drawn from a seeded PRNG; the first draw meeting the pre-registered representativeness rule (alternations within ±1 SD of the process mean; 7–13 heads) was kept.

charts.description: Each chart shows 30 branches of a fictional retailer (synthetic data). 'planted' = bivariate normal with population ρ = ±0.5. 'independent' = ρ = 0, first draw kept. 'selected' = ρ = 0, but the most correlated of 100 candidate draws was kept (selection effect). Variable labels were assigned by a seeded shuffle independent of the ground truth. Axes use the same padding rule for every chart; no trend lines or statistics are shown during testing.
